title: Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces for Hard Math Problems
abstract: arXiv:2611.34928v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-training large language models (LLMs) for mathematical reasoning often relies on accepted traces whose final answers pass a verifier. For hard math problems, however, such traces can be rare under independent Monte Carlo (MC) sampling. To address this, we propose Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces (DART), a trace-mining method that starts from a rejected trace, decomposes it into reasoning steps, and ranks them by position-weighted uncertainty. It then generates deliberately distinct alternative candidates for highly ranked steps using reference-answer guidance and a meta-thought before completing the resulting traces. On greedy-unsolved DeepMath-103K problems, DART recovers 37% more problems than MC sampling at a matched number of generated traces. translated_title: 面向复杂数学问题的多样化替代推理轨迹
translated_abstract: 针对数学推理的大语言模型（LLM）后训练通常依赖于最终答案能通过验证器检验的合格轨迹。然而，对于复杂数学问题，在独立蒙特卡洛（MC）采样下，这类轨迹可能非常稀少。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了多样化替代推理轨迹（Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces，DART），这是一种轨迹挖掘方法：它从一条被拒绝的轨迹出发，将其分解为推理步骤，并按位置加权不确定性进行排序；随后利用参考答案引导和元思考（meta-thought），为排名靠前的步骤生成刻意不同的替代候选，最后完成由此产生的完整轨迹。在贪心解码未能解决的DeepMath-103K问题上，在生成轨迹数量相同的条件下，DART比MC采样多解决37%的问题；其每个已恢复问题的估计生成成本几乎相同，而每条合格轨迹的成本降低了30%。在DART挖掘的轨迹上对Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct进行后训练取得了显著提升。
tldr: 提出了DART轨迹挖掘方法，通过分解被拒绝的推理轨迹并基于位置加权不确定性与参考答案引导生成刻意不同的替代推理步骤，在相同生成成本下比蒙特卡洛采样多恢复37%的复杂数学问题，且每条合格轨迹成本降低30%。
en_tdlr: DART is a trace-mining method that recovers more alternative reasoning traces for hard math problems by decomposing rejected traces and generating deliberately distinct step-level alternatives guided by position-weighted uncertainty and reference answers, solving 37% more problems than Monte Carlo sampling at matched generation cost while cutting the cost per accepted trace by 30%.
